infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: HazardNet uses your location to display local multi-hazard agricultural disaster alerts and high-precision weather forecasts for your district.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: HazardNet uses your camera to let you submit field photos of disaster events. Photos stay on this device until you submit them.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: HazardNet needs access to your photo library to let you attach existing photos to field reports.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: HazardNet uses reminders to schedule emergency crop protection directives.
